title.narrative: Nigeria Energy Support Programme (NESP) III

description.narrative: Engagement with public and private entities, public or industry led (self) regulatory bodies and business organisations in the sector will be continued to achieve better implementation of sector policies, regulations and standards. Such engagement will build on previous work under NESP and take place at federal or state level and include women associations. It will also promote the development of new policies, regulations and standards where necessary. The project will scale up its activities on promoting energy efficiency in the industry and building sector with possible financing for energy efficiency measures.
